Being able to block a subverse from /v/all is a great idea. I think making it a dropdown menu would be even better. A dropdown would allow you to put other related and future options - such as block, subscribe, block user, etc. It would also reduce the probability of accidentally clicking block (which can be dangerous w/o a list of blocked subverses).
The block button in /v/all is a welcome edition, but making it a dropdown would make it more versatile and help avoid accidents.

I don't block subverses that often (would rather be aware of whats there and choose to ignore it if I don't like it... rather than living in a gated community of one), but I think the added features of a dropdown would be an improvement for everyone... even if they don't specifically want to block subverses.

I also think that a dropdown menu for voting would be an improvement over up/down (more informative), but I realize that complicates things (specifically how to rank submissions), so I'm not all that worried about it right this second. Just throwing that out there.
